rejected_findings.title: 'Calm boards stay byte-identical' claim vs 34 regenerated goldens, none shown unchanged

No violation present.

findings.title: Palcheck §8 routed legs (d)+(e) index pipe_congestion without the testing_lvl_ok guard the other legs use
findings.detail: A premise-broken fixture (testing_lvl_ok false) skips (a)/(b)/(c) but (d)+(e) still index state.crisis.pipe_congestion[ps8] — the resize above is also gated on testing_lvl_ok, so the slice may be short/empty and palcheck panics instead of failing clean, masking the summary.
findings.recommended_fix: Wrap the (d)+(e) block in the same `if testing_lvl_ok` guard as (a)-(c).
findings.verifier_note: Read in worktree: (a)/(b)/(c) wrapped in `if testing_lvl_ok`; (d)+(e) unguarded; resize gated identically. 4 lenses independently flagged it.

findings.title: look_l1_test feeds world-px band values into congested_halo_width's screen-px parameter at scaled rungs
findings.detail: The draw site passes screen px (`band := link_width_capped(...) * v.scale`), but the test passes 3.5/4.5 world px with scale 1.4/2.0 and its comments restate the world reading ('max(9+10, 24)' for a call of (4.5, 2.0)). Numerically insensitive at every pair (the floor dominates: 16.8/16.8/24 either reading; the scale-1.0 pair is exactly faithful), so the law pin holds — the stated interpretation is wrong and will mislead future retunes.
findings.recommended_fix: Pass band_screen = world × scale in the pairs (or rename the pairs' intent), and fix the inline comments to match the call arithmetic.
findings.verifier_note: Draw site verified at view.odin:993; test comments verified in look_l1_test.odin. 3 lenses independently flagged it.

findings.title: Camera zoom band 1.0..4.0 restated as literals in three parsers while CAM_ZOOM_MIN/MAX constants exist
findings.detail: The band literal appears in the demo parser, the motion-strip CLI arg, and the strip override guard, all commented as 'the camera band' — while CAM_ZOOM_MIN :: 1.0 / CAM_ZOOM_MAX :: 4.0 exist in app/render/camera.odin and the harness already imports the render package. A future band retune updates one constant and silently misses three guards.
findings.recommended_fix: Derive the three band tests from rnd.CAM_ZOOM_MIN/CAM_ZOOM_MAX (the harness already imports rnd).
findings.verifier_note: All three literals + the constants verified in the worktree.

findings.title: Palcheck §8 end-cap leak scan can never fail (the halo cap renders under the node sprite)
findings.detail: capa8 is the node's screen CENTER; the end-cap circle is DrawCircleV(a, w*0.5) (~12px radius at scale 2) drawn in the BUNDLES pass, and draw_world draws nodes AFTER bundles — the node sprite (≥ ~40px tall at ACCESS z=2.0) covers the whole cap circle, so the ±floor_px scan at the cap column can never see halo pixels whether or not a leak exists. Vacuous by geometry; the section's other legs are live (the delete-the-bump leg was independently mutation-proven this round).
findings.recommended_fix: Scan the cap leak just OUTSIDE the sprite footprint (e.g. at node_center ± sprite_half + w*0.5), or drop the sub-scan and say why.
findings.verifier_note: Draw order + sprite sizing verified; radius-vs-coverage arithmetic in the verifier note.

findings.title: Motion-strip capture-altitude behavior (new demo-zoom default + zoom= override) has zero automated coverage
findings.detail: apply_capture_zoom's extraction + the new zoom= override validation (band test, duplicate-token usage error) ship with no unit coverage — grep over harness/*_test.odin and app/render/*_test.odin finds zero references; the corpus only exercises the default path.
findings.recommended_fix: A small unit test on the parse+normalize path (zoom= parse, band rejection, duplicate rejection) closes it.

findings.detail: P0 (the A1 floor law) is heavily covered: unit law test + palcheck §8 ×5 live legs + corpus 49/49 + this round's independent RED-then-GREEN mutation legs. The uncovered motion-strip override path is a P2 gap → CONCERNS, not FAIL.

findings.title: Out-of-band zoom override silently ignored in run_motion_strip but usage-errors in the CLI caller
findings.detail: `if zoom_override >= 1.0 && zoom_override <= 4.0 { strip_zoom = zoom_override }` falls through silently out-of-band while main.odin's CLI parse usage-errors the same value — an inconsistency only reachable by a future non-CLI caller (the 0 sentinel is the intended default).
findings.recommended_fix: Either trust the caller (document the sentinel contract) or mirror the usage error.
findings.verifier_note: Verified in the worktree; defense-in-depth asymmetry only.

findings.title: 0.57/0.43 congested-blend restated in three places despite the diff's ONE-derivation doctrine
findings.detail: The width law got ONE derivation (congested_halo_width) but the blend literal stays duplicated in both draw_bundles branches and again in palcheck §8's halo_blend — the same drift argument the diff's own comment makes for the width.
findings.recommended_fix: Hoist a blend helper next to congested_halo_width (draw-side; palcheck's copy may stay as the independent measurement oracle).
findings.verifier_note: Verified in the worktree. (palcheck's copy is arguably a deliberate independent oracle — the draw-side pair is the real dup.)

findings.title: §8 testing_lvl_ok omits the edit-error result its own premise check requires
findings.detail: The premise check asserts `testing_lvl_ok && perr8 == .None` but testing_lvl_ok itself excludes perr8 — with a failed pipe edit the legs would run on a pipeless fixture and fail confusingly (band 0) rather than skipping on the premise.
findings.verifier_note: Verified from the diff + worktree; diagnostic-quality only (a pipeless fixture still fails loudly, never false-passes).

findings.title: Doc-hygiene constraint met by substitution: LOOK-SPEC line deferred, amendment recorded on tracked canon instead
findings.detail: The spec's 'ONE line in the repo's LOOK-SPEC' is unmet literally: LOOK-SPEC.md is untracked in git so the PR cannot carry it. The amendment IS recorded on the tracked LOOK §3 canon comment + the PR body, and deferred-work.md routes the mirror with evidence.
findings.recommended_fix: Mirror the line into LOOK-SPEC.md when it lands in git (already routed in deferred-work.md).
findings.verifier_note: Documented, routed substitution — note-grade, not an AC violation.

findings.title: Routed-calm leg pins leak-only, not width — asymmetric vs the inline calm covenant pin

findings.recommended_fix: Add the routed calm stroke-width scan to (e).
